observations: Exact visible ClassPad fx-880BTG PLUS. All native key histories retained; Radian, MathI/MathO unless the sequence changes settings.
EXE on the last variable draft accepts its value and selects Run; a second EXE executes CALC. Frames named calc-form-* represent the form, not an execution error.

Accepted CALC form values are buffered until Run. Cancelling the form leaves variable memory unchanged. Run writes the accepted values even when the expression then raises Math ERROR. Independent x=7/cancel/run and x=0/error/recall probes are included.
An error in a variable draft (1/0 or 1+) returns to that draft with Back, AC, EXE or OK. Back from the recovered draft clears it and restores the selected value; Back without a draft exits CALC.
An execution error (1/x at x=0, after Run) returns to the main expression. Arrows, digits and SETTINGS are ignored while the error is visible. Correcting x to 2 and running gives 1/2.

SETTINGS is ignored in CALC forms. LineI/LineO shows the selected variable and Run on consecutive lines. Vietnamese and English execution errors, multi-variable drafts and correction of the second variable are included.
